description: Authored English search-intent cases for the twenty-two-mode Fluid Search demo; not user data. Two cases per mode in each disjoint split. Includes explicit negation, topic mentions and ambiguity. Separate from historical search-v1/search-v2 reports and archived composer datasets.

cases.draft: mercury
cases.rationale: The topic could mean a planet, element, deity or title; it does not clearly request any specialized tool.

cases.draft: Explain what a barrel roll is, without animating anything.
cases.rationale: The user requests an explanation and explicitly rejects the visual trick.

cases.draft: Will I need a raincoat in Tokyo on Friday?
cases.rationale: Practical rain planning implies a forecast.

cases.draft: wind forecast Wellington tonight
cases.rationale: A brief forecast query is sufficient without a complete sentence.

cases.draft: How is Microsoft stock trading right now?
cases.rationale: Current equity trading performance is a finance lookup.

cases.draft: Show the past month of gold prices
cases.rationale: A market price history belongs to finance rather than generic date filtering.

cases.draft: Where can I get vegan lunch around Bugis?
cases.rationale: The user wants nearby physical restaurants.

cases.draft: Walking directions to the nearest pharmacy
cases.rationale: Directions to a local service use place controls.

cases.draft: Where is Inside Out 2 playing near Orchard?
cases.rationale: The request concerns cinema screenings.

cases.draft: Which animated movies can I watch at the cinema tonight?
cases.rationale: Film discovery with a screening time belongs to movies.

cases.draft: How many millilitres are in two cups?
cases.rationale: A quantity in different units asks for conversion.

cases.draft: 9am in Singapore is what time in London?
cases.rationale: Translating a clock time between zones is conversion.

cases.draft: another word for meticulous
cases.rationale: The request is for a word synonym.

cases.draft: What does ephemeral mean?
cases.rationale: The request asks for a word definition.

cases.draft: Canon camera instruction manual as a PDF
cases.rationale: The user wants a downloadable document format.

cases.draft: Find a downloadable PowerPoint project proposal template
cases.rationale: A downloadable slide deck is a document-format search.

cases.draft: Find passport renewal instructions only on the Singapore government website
cases.rationale: The user explicitly limits the source website.

cases.draft: Limit my search for panda conservation to WWF pages
cases.rationale: An organization website restriction is the requested refinement.

cases.draft: What are the newest developments in reusable rockets?
cases.rationale: The user asks for recent developments rather than an explanatory history.

cases.draft: Breaking headlines about the election
cases.rationale: This is explicitly a news request.

cases.draft: Find articles about remote work published before 2020
cases.rationale: The primary search refinement is a publication-date cutoff.

cases.draft: Show urban planning studies released during the last six months
cases.rationale: The user requests a time window for publications without a download-format requirement.

cases.draft: Only results with the exact words sustainable urban drainage
cases.rationale: The refinement requires exact wording.

cases.draft: Coffee brewing guides with every espresso result excluded
cases.rationale: The user explicitly removes an unwanted topic from the results.

cases.draft: What is 81 / 9 + 6?
cases.rationale: The request is arithmetic, without converting one unit to another.

cases.draft: Split $132 among 6 friends and add a 10% tip
cases.rationale: The user asks for a bill total and per-person arithmetic.

cases.draft: Give me a 12 minute countdown for the pasta
cases.rationale: A cooking countdown uses the timer, not a count-up stopwatch.

cases.draft: Start a 1 minute 30 second tea timer
cases.rationale: The requested countdown combines minutes and seconds.

cases.draft: Measure elapsed time for this task with a stopwatch
cases.rationale: The user requests count-up elapsed-time measurement.

cases.draft: Let me record laps on a stopwatch
cases.rationale: Lap recording is an explicit stopwatch use.

cases.draft: I need a metronome at 96 bpm for guitar practice
cases.rationale: A regular music-practice tempo requests the metronome.

cases.draft: Play a regular click at 60 beats per minute
cases.rationale: A regular tempo-controlled click is a metronome rather than a game or timer.

cases.draft: Let me adjust a coral colour
cases.rationale: The user wants to manipulate a supported named colour.

cases.draft: Inspect #2a9d8f in the colour picker
cases.rationale: The explicit hex and colour picker request is unambiguous.

cases.draft: Earth versus Mars: show the differences
cases.rationale: The supported pair and explicit difference request call for comparison.

cases.draft: What would days and years look like on Mars compared with Earth?
cases.rationale: The user requests a comparison of planetary day and year lengths, not a simulation.

cases.draft: Let me change a planet's mass and watch the satellite's orbit
cases.rationale: Changing central mass and seeing its effect is an interactive orbit experiment.

cases.draft: Visualize a circular orbit and let me adjust its radius
cases.rationale: The requested radius control matches the simplified orbit simulation.

cases.draft: I want to play a two-player tic tac toe game here
cases.rationale: The user explicitly requests the supported local two-player game.

cases.draft: Open a noughts-and-crosses board so we can play
cases.rationale: A playable board is requested, rather than an explanation of the game.

cases.draft: Show me the barrel roll Easter egg
cases.rationale: The user requests the visual trick itself.

cases.draft: Tilt the search widget with the askew trick
cases.rationale: The request concerns a visual Easter egg rather than colour, search filtering or gameplay.

cases.draft: let me jump a little T rex over cacti
cases.rationale: The visitor requests the jumping dinosaur game or its explicit 404 Easter egg.

cases.draft: open the offline dinosaur runner
cases.rationale: The visitor requests the jumping dinosaur game or its explicit 404 Easter egg.
